The '''Escabar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Escabar]].
